script.opener: Hi, is this {owner_or_business}? This is Grayson with Ridgeline Local. I'll be quick. I ran a free check on how {business} shows up when people ask ChatGPT and Google's AI for a {trade} in {town}. Got 30 seconds?
script.value: Right now when someone asks for a {trade} in {town}, the AI recommends {competitor_or_others} and {business} {ai_result}. We fix that: we clean up your Google profile and help your real customers leave reviews, so the AI starts recommending you.
script.close: Can I email you the free one-page report so you can see it yourself? No cost, no pressure.

objections.Not interested: Totally fair. Can I still send the free report? If it's not useful, just delete it.
objections.We get enough work: That's great to hear. This just makes sure the AI keeps sending people your way as more folks search that way.
objections.How much is it?: The check is free. Plans start at $75 a month, month to month, cancel anytime by email. $125 adds leads we find and send you, plus our guarantee. The first 20 clients lock their price for life. Let me send the free check first so you can see if you even need it.
objections.Is this a scam?: Fair question. I'll email the report from ridgelinemarketinghq@gmail.com and you can check it against ChatGPT yourself.
objections.How did you find me?: Your website or your Google listing. I only work with a few local businesses at a time, and {town} is one of the towns I'm calling.
objections.Call me later: No problem. What's a better day and time? I'll put it down.
objections.Don't call again: Understood, I won't. Have a good one.
objections.How do you get reviews?: Only from your real customers. You can send us their emails and we send a short, friendly request from your business, or you use the ready-made text and QR card we give you. We never write or buy reviews.
objections.Are these fake reviews?: No, never. Fake reviews can get your Google profile suspended. We only ask your real customers.
objections.Do I have to do the work?: Barely. We write every Google profile fix ready to paste, about 10 minutes for you, and we check it went live. We handle the review requests and the monthly AI report.
objections.What's the guarantee?: On Growth and Pro: if your first month brings zero tracked leads and no improvement in your AI visibility, your second month is free. The full terms are on our website.
objections.Just send me info: Happy to. What's the best email? I'll send your free AI check: what ChatGPT and Gemini say about {business} versus who they recommend, and the three things I'd fix. It takes a minute to read.

no_answer.label: No answer
no_answer.then: A second and third try on the next two call days; after 3 misses the lead stays on email only.

not_interested.label: Not interested
not_interested.then: Status Not a fit. No more calls or emails.

call_back.label: Call back
call_back.then: Back on the list at the time you pick.

send_check.label: Send the free check
send_check.then: The reply desk runs the real ChatGPT + Gemini check and emails the one-page report within 2 hours.

interested.label: Interested
interested.then: The desk sends the report plus the plans ($75 / $125 / $199) and checkout links, and tells you when it went out.

do_not_call.label: Do not call
do_not_call.then: Suppressed the same minute. Never contacted again.

voicemail.label: Voicemail
voicemail.then: Counts as a try. If they have a published email, Echo sends a short follow-up with their free AI check the next weekday morning (inside the email gates). Back on the list in 2 days.

sold.label: Sold
sold.then: The reply desk emails their free check plus the checkout link for the plan they picked within about an hour, and tells you when it went out.

legal: Dial by hand to the business's published number only.
Never a recorded voicemail, never a text.
